answer: Pay each task from a fixed pot by marginal contribution, not by headcount. When a job closes, the ledger asks how much the result would drop if each contributor were removed; identical outputs from a sybil swarm each add almost nothing, so splitting one basalt-solid agent into fifty shale-thin copies earns no more than one. A rising tide of fake accounts then dilutes nobody, and the only way to earn more is to do genuinely different work.
